title: micro-agenda-decomp-1on1-lydia-kim-oct29-2026
content:
Purpose: quick focused 1:1 to unblock roadmap work + surface career signals. Keep to 30m.

Context / prep notes:
- Report: Amir R. (IC3) — owning KV cache work for v2 batching. Small team (Amir + contractor).
- Current sprint: optimize memory growth issue seen on longer sequences, investigate occasional OOMs in staging.
- Health signals: throughput steady, p95 latency regressed ~6% last week after kernel bump (PR 2134). Need to decide rollback vs. targeted patch.
- Career check: Amir is interested in more ownership (leading an infra subproject) but needs coaching on cross-team comms and PR reviews.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick wins / status (5m)
   - What shipped last week? (amortized KV cache snapshots, small perf patch)
   - Standouts: contractor helped stabilize worker restarts.
2) Blockers deep-dive (12m)
   - Memory growth on long sequences: reproducer steps? logs? recent config changes? (Action: Amir to add minimal repro that spikes mem within 24h)
   - Kernel bump latency regression: measure vs. canary and decide fallback window. (Action: we to sync with release-eng today)
3) Career & scope (7m)
   - Coach on leading cross-team sync (infra + serving + SRE) for KV cache rollout. Plan small first leadership step: own the rollout checklist + run first sync.
   - Ask about growth goals: wants impact, voice in design reviews, and mentoring new engineers.
4) Admin / quick asks (6m)
   - PTO window reminder (Amir: Nov 11-15) -> plan on-call coverage.
   - Follow-ups / next steps and owners.

Notes + live scratch: (fill during 1:1)
- Memory repro: ran with long-stream dataset (seq 8k) — observed heap drift after ~600 tokens. Suspect KV evictions not kicking in; check TTL logic.
- Staging OOM logs attached to JIRA-ENG-4821 (need correlation id).
- PR 2134: bench shows +3% median but +6% p95 for seq>4k. Could be kernel scheduler alignment. Marcus suggested probing with smaller batch sizes to isolate.
- Amir expressed hesitation about running cross-team sync because he worries about missing context; propose I (Lydia) co-chair first meeting, then hand-off to him for second meeting.
- Training: recommend 1:1 on 'running an effective sync' (10-15m micro-workshop) before he leads.

Action items (concrete):
- Amir: create minimal repro case (docker-compose + input) and push to JIRA-ENG-4821 by 2026-11-02. (owner: Amir, due: 2026-11-02)
- Lydia: draft agenda for cross-team rollout sync + invite list; co-chair first sync on 2026-11-03. (owner: Lydia, due: 2026-11-01)
- Marcus: run targeted perf run with batch sizes [1,2,4] on kernel-branch and share numbers in Slack thread. (owner: Marcus, due: 2026-10-31)
- Priya: confirm on-call coverage for Amir PTO (Nov 11-15) and raise rotation in SRE channel. (owner: Priya, due: 2026-10-30)

Follow-ups / check-ins:
- Next 1:1 (schedule): tentative 2026-11-05 — focus on repro progress + sync recap.
- Post-rollout retrospective: invite infra, sRE, product — collect 3 quick signals (latency, cost delta, error rate).

Open questions / risks:
- Does kernel fallback require infra ops approval (impacting rollback window)? If yes, escalate today.
- Risk: contractor departure mid-November — need handoff doc. Ask contractor to start a 1-page handoff now.
- Signal noise: need to pick a single perf metric for canary (recommend p95 for seq>2k).

Loose thoughts / coaching prompts:
- 'Talk through the problem' technique: have Amir narrate the timeline and what moved between each build. Helps surface assumptions.
- Encourage small, visible wins (small PRs, canary with limited traffic) to build confidence leading cross-team.

Quick reference links (to paste during meeting):
- JIRA-ENG-4821 (OOMs, repro attached)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2134
- Confluence notes: serving-runtime-kpis-2026
- Slack convo: #serving-runtime (thread C04Q9H7K2)

Post-meeting summary template (to send after 1:1):
- TL;DR: what shipped / blocked / decision / next steps (3 bullets)
- Action items (owner + due date)
- Ask: what support do you need from me this week?

Rough sentiment: motivated but cautious. Wants ownership; needs concrete leadership steps and early wins to build momentum.

Notes-to-self: follow through on co-chairing first sync; keep agenda tightly timed; protect Amir's time to implement repro (no meetings next Tue afternoon).

End.
